source.text: יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מָלַ֗ךְ בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְחָמֵשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָתֵ֨שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ אֲבִיָּ֖ה בַּת־זְכַרְיָֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Hezekiah reigned, a son of twenty and five year[s], and twenty and nine year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem; and [the] name of his mother [was] Abijah daughter of Zechariah.

en.L: Hezekiah became king [as] a son of twenty-five years, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. And the name of his mother [was] Abijah daughter of Zechariah.
en.B: Hezekiah became king when he was twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Abijah daughter of Zechariah.
en.R: Hezekiah became king at the age of twenty-five, and he ruled for twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

es.L: Ezequías comenzó a reinar [siendo] hijo de veinticinco años, y reinó veintinueve años en Jerusalén. Y el nombre de su madre [era] Abías hija de Zacarías.
es.B: Ezequías comenzó a reinar cuando tenía veinticinco años, y reinó veintinueve años en Jerusalén. Su madre se llamaba Abías hija de Zacarías.
es.R: Ezequías comenzó a reinar a los veinticinco años, y gobernó en Jerusalén durante veintinueve años. Su madre se llamaba Abías y era hija de Zacarías.

fr.L: Ézéchias devint roi [à l’âge de] vingt-cinq ans, et il régna vingt-neuf ans à Jérusalem. Et le nom de sa mère [était] Abiya fille de Zacharie.
fr.B: Ézéchias devint roi à l’âge de vingt-cinq ans, et il régna vingt-neuf ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s’appelait Abiya, fille de Zacharie.
fr.R: Ézéchias est devenu roi à l’âge de vingt-cinq ans, et il a régné à Jérusalem pendant vingt-neuf ans. Sa mère s’appelait Abiya ; c’était la fille de Zacharie.

sw.L: Hezekia akaanza kutawala [akiwa] mwana wa miaka ishirini na mitano, naye akatawala miaka ishirini na tisa huko Yerusalemu. Na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] Abiya binti Zekaria.
sw.B: Hezekia alianza kutawala alipokuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitano, naye akatawala miaka ishirini na tisa huko Yerusalemu. Mama yake aliitwa Abiya binti Zekaria.
sw.R: Hezekia alianza kutawala akiwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitano, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka ishirini na tisa. Mama yake aliitwa Abiya binti Zekaria.

vi.L: Ê-xê-chia lên làm vua khi [được] hai mươi lăm tuổi, và trị vì hai mươi chín năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Tên mẹ vua [là] A-bi-gia con gái Xa-cha-ri.
vi.B: Ê-xê-chia lên làm vua khi được hai mươi lăm tuổi và trị vì hai mươi chín năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Mẹ vua tên là A-bi-gia con gái Xa-cha-ri.
vi.R: Ê-xê-chia lên làm vua lúc hai mươi lăm tuổi, và vua cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem hai mươi chín năm. Mẹ vua tên là A-bi-gia, con gái Xa-cha-ri.

ko.L: 히스기야가 25세에 왕이 되어, 예루살렘에서 29년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그의 어머니의 이름은 스가랴의 딸 아비야였다.
ko.B: 히스기야는 25세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 29년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 스가랴의 딸 아비야였다.
ko.R: 히스기야는 25세에 왕이 되었고, 예루살렘에서 29년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니는 스가랴의 딸 아비야였다.

decisions.choice: a retelling of 2 Kings 18:1-2, with three differences
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 18:1-2 dates Hezekiah's accession by the third year of Hoshea king of Israel; Chronicles leaves that date out, as it leaves out most dates tied to the northern kings. Chronicles spells the king's name in its longer form throughout, and it names his mother Abijah where 2 Kings 18:2 has the short form Abi. The rest of the verse is the same.

decisions.choice: a son of twenty-five years: twenty-five years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being "a son of" so many years, as in 2 Kings 18:2.

decisions.choice: his mother: the queen mother named in the formula
decisions.reason: For each king of Judah the formula names his mother, who held a place of honor at court (1 Kings 15:13). Abijah means "my father is Yahweh".

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 18:2, with the name first
decisions.reason: The Hebrew opens with the king's name, so each level begins "Hezekiah became king" and then keeps the wording used in 2 Kings 18:2 and in the accession formula throughout these books.

decisions.choice: the wording of Spanish 2 Kings 18:2, with the name first; "Abías"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew opens with the king's name, so each level begins with "Ezequías" and then keeps its Kings wording. Chronicles spells the queen mother's name in full (Abijah), so Spanish writes "Abías" where 2 Kings 18:2 has "Abí".

decisions.choice: "Abiya"
decisions.reason: Chronicles gives the queen mother's full name where French 2 Kings 18:2 has "Abi"; French keeps each verse's form, as "Abiya" in Kings.

decisions.choice: Abiya
decisions.reason: Chronicles gives the queen mother's full name, Abijah, where 2 Kings 18:2 has Abi; the Swahili follows each book, and otherwise keeps the wording of 2 Kings 18:2-3.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 18:2 with the name first and "A-bi-gia"
decisions.reason: Chronicles spells the queen mother's name Abijah where Kings has Abi (m1); the Vietnamese follows each book's form and reuses the Kings formula.

decisions.choice: "아비야", the longer form Chronicles has, in the wording of 2 Kings 18:2 with figures
decisions.reason: Each book keeps its own form of the name (m1); ages and years are in figures in this block.

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה דָּוִ֥יד אָבִֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the right in [the] eyes of Yahweh, according to all that had done David his father.

en.L: And he did the right in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, according to all that David his father had done.
en.B: He did what was right in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, in every way as his ancestor David had done.
en.R: He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was right, in every way, just as his ancestor David had done.

es.L: E hizo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, conforme a todo lo que había hecho David su padre.
es.B: Hizo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, en todo como lo había hecho su antepasado David.
es.R: Hizo lo que agrada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en todo, tal como lo había hecho su antepasado David.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est droit aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, selon tout ce qu’avait fait David son père.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est juste aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, en tout point comme son ancêtre David.
fr.R: Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare bon, en tout point, comme son ancêtre David l’avait fait.

sw.L: Naye akafanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sawasawa na yote aliyoyafanya Daudi baba yake.
sw.B: Alifanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, katika kila jambo kama babu yake Daudi alivyofanya.
sw.R: Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mema katika kila jambo, kama babu yake Daudi alivyofanya.

vi.L: Vua làm điều ngay thẳng trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, theo mọi điều Đa-vít tổ phụ vua đã làm.
vi.B: Vua làm điều ngay thẳng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đúng như mọi điều Đa-vít tổ tiên vua đã làm.
vi.R: Vua làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là phải về mọi phương diện, đúng như Đa-vít tổ tiên vua đã làm.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 그의 조상 다윗이 한 모든 일대로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 올바른 일을 했다.
ko.B: 그는 그의 조상 다윗이 한 그대로, 모든 면에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 올바른 일을 했다.
ko.R: 그는 모든 면에서 그의 조상 다윗처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 옳다고 하신 일을 했다.

decisions.choice: the same verdict as 2 Kings 18:3, word for word
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 2 Kings 18:3, and the wording is kept. Kings goes on to say that Hezekiah removed the high places (2 Kings 18:4); Chronicles turns first to the temple and tells of the high places later (31:1).

decisions.choice: did what was right in Yahweh's eyes: the good verdict, without any reservation
decisions.reason: Hezekiah is measured against David "according to all" he did, the highest praise the formula gives. Chronicles gives four chapters (29-32) to show what that meant.

decisions.choice: David his father: his ancestor David
decisions.reason: David lived some three hundred years before Hezekiah. "Father" also means a forefather, as in 2 Kings 18:3.

decisions.choice: did the right in [the] eyes of / did what was right in the sight of / did what the LORD said was right
decisions.reason: The wording kept for the good verdict at each level throughout these books.

decisions.choice: his ancestor David
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "ancestor" for "father" wherever David is called the father of a later king, as 2 Kings 18:3 does; Literal keeps "father".

source.text: ה֣וּא בַשָּׁנָה֩ הָרִאשׁוֹנָ֨ה לְמָלְכ֜וֹ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן פָּתַ֛ח אֶת־דַּלְת֥וֹת בֵּית־יְהוָ֖ה וַֽיְחַזְּקֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: He, in the year the first of his reigning, in the month the first, opened [the] doors of [the] house of Yahweh and strengthened them.

en.L: He, in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and repaired them.
en.B: In his first year as king, in the first month, he opened the doors of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and made them strong again.
en.R: In the first month of the first year that he was king, Hezekiah opened the doors of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple and repaired them.

es.L: Él, en el primer año de su reinado, en el mes primero, abrió las puertas de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y las reparó.
es.B: En su primer año como rey, en el mes primero, abrió las puertas de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y las reforzó de nuevo.
es.R: En el primer mes del primer año de su reinado, Ezequías abrió las puertas del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y las reparó.

fr.L: Lui, la première année de son règne, au premier mois, ouvrit les portes de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et les répara.
fr.B: La première année de son règne, au premier mois, il ouvrit les portes de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et les remit en état.
fr.R: Au premier mois de la première année de son règne, Ézéchias a ouvert les portes du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et il les a réparées.

sw.L: Yeye, katika mwaka wa kwanza wa kutawala kwake, katika mwezi wa kwanza, akaifungua milango ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akaiimarisha.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wake wa kwanza wa utawala, katika mwezi wa kwanza, aliifungua milango ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akaifanya imara tena.
sw.R: Katika mwezi wa kwanza wa mwaka wa kwanza wa utawala wake, Hezekia aliifungua milango ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akaitengeneza.

vi.L: Chính vua, vào năm thứ nhất triều đại mình, tháng thứ nhất, mở các cửa nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và sửa chữa chúng.
vi.B: Năm thứ nhất triều đại mình, vào tháng thứ nhất, vua mở các cửa nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và làm cho chúng vững chắc lại.
vi.R: Vào tháng thứ nhất của năm đầu tiên làm vua, Ê-xê-chia mở các cửa đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và sửa chữa chúng.

ko.L: 그가, 그가 다스린 첫해 첫째 달에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 문들을 열고 그것들을 보수했다.
ko.B: 그는 왕이 된 첫해 첫째 달에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 문들을 열고 다시 튼튼하게 고쳤다.
ko.R: 히스기야는 왕이 된 첫해 첫째 달에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 문들을 열고 고쳤다.

decisions.choice: He: Hezekiah himself, set first for emphasis
decisions.reason: The verse begins with the pronoun, which Hebrew does not need. It puts Hezekiah in the foreground and sets what he did against what his father Ahaz had done: Ahaz had shut the doors of the house of Yahweh (28:24).

decisions.choice: in the first month: the first month of the year, in spring
decisions.reason: The first month of Israel's year (Exodus 12:2) was the month of the Passover. The phrase most likely means the first month of the calendar in Hezekiah's first year, not the first month after he took the throne. The cleansing took until the sixteenth day of this month (verse 17), past the day of the Passover, which is why the Passover was kept in the second month (30:2-3).

decisions.choice: strengthened them: repaired them
decisions.reason: The verb means to make strong. Used of buildings it means to repair (24:5, 12). Ahaz had stripped the temple (28:24; 2 Kings 16:17-18), and later Hezekiah himself took the gold from these doors to pay Assyria (2 Kings 18:16).

decisions.choice: made them strong again (Balanced); Hezekiah ... the LORD's temple (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of the verb, "make strong", with "again" for the repair of what Ahaz had damaged. Readable names Hezekiah for "he" and says "temple" for "house of the LORD", as Readable does in these books.

source.text: וַיָּבֵ֥א אֶת־הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְאֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וַיַּֽאַסְפֵ֖ם לִרְח֥וֹב הַמִּזְרָֽח׃

records.literal_gloss: And he brought the priests and the Levites and gathered them to [the] square of the east.

en.L: And he brought in the priests and the Levites and gathered them in the square of the east.
en.B: He brought in the priests and the Levites and gathered them in the open square on the east side.
en.R: He brought together the priests and the Levites in the open square on the east side of the temple.

es.L: E hizo venir a los sacerdotes y a los levitas, y los reunió en la plaza oriental.
es.B: Hizo venir a los sacerdotes y a los levitas y los reunió en la plaza del lado oriental.
es.R: Reunió a los sacerdotes y a los levitas en la plaza que estaba al lado este del templo.

fr.L: Et il fit venir les prêtres et les Lévites, et il les rassembla sur la place de l’orient.
fr.B: Il fit venir les prêtres et les Lévites et les rassembla sur la place, du côté est.
fr.R: Il a réuni les prêtres et les Lévites sur la place qui se trouvait du côté est du temple.

sw.L: Akawaleta makuhani na Walawi, akawakusanya katika uwanja wa mashariki.
sw.B: Aliwaleta makuhani na Walawi, akawakusanya katika uwanja ulio upande wa mashariki.
sw.R: Aliwakusanya makuhani na Walawi katika uwanja ulio upande wa mashariki wa hekalu.

vi.L: Vua đem các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi vào, nhóm họ lại tại quảng trường phía đông.
vi.B: Vua cho gọi các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi vào, nhóm họ lại tại quảng trường phía đông.
vi.R: Vua tập họp các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi tại quảng trường phía đông đền thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 제사장들과 레위인들을 데려와서 동쪽 광장에 모았다.
ko.B: 그는 제사장들과 레위인들을 불러들여 동쪽 광장에 모았다.
ko.R: 그는 제사장들과 레위인들을 성전 동쪽 광장에 불러 모았다.

decisions.choice: the priests and the Levites: the two ranks of temple servants
decisions.reason: The priests were the descendants of Aaron, who served at the altar and inside the sanctuary. The other Levites helped them, kept the gates, carried, cleaned and led the singing (1 Chronicles 23:27-32). Both ranks are called here, and the work in verses 16-17 is shared between them.

decisions.choice: the square of the east: an open space east of the temple
alternatives: a square on the east side of the city
decisions.reason: The temple faced east, so this was most likely the open ground in front of its entrance (compare Ezra 10:9, "the square of the house of God"). It may instead be a square on the east side of the city.

decisions.choice: of the temple
decisions.reason: Readable names the temple as the place the square lay east of, which the Hebrew implies.

source.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לָהֶ֖ם שְׁמָע֣וּנִי הַלְוִיִּ֑ם עַתָּ֣ה הִֽתְקַדְּשׁ֗וּ וְקַדְּשׁוּ֙ אֶת־בֵּ֤ית יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֔ם וְהוֹצִ֥יאוּ אֶת־הַנִּדָּ֖ה מִן־הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to them, hear me, the Levites! Now consecrate yourselves, and consecrate [the] house of Yahweh, [the] God of your fathers, and bring out the impurity from the holy [place].

en.L: And he said to them, "Hear me, Levites! Now consecrate yourselves, and consecrate the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of your fathers, and bring out the impurity from the holy place.
en.B: He said to them, "Listen to me, you Levites! Consecrate yourselves now. Then consecrate the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of your ancestors, and carry everything impure out of the holy place.
en.R: He said to them, "Listen to me, Levites! Make yourselves holy now, and make the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of your ancestors, holy too. Take everything that makes the holy place unclean, and carry it out.

es.L: Y les dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Óiganme|Oídme}}, levitas! {{plural_you:Santifíquense|Santificaos}} ahora, y {{plural_you:santifiquen|santificad}} la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el Dios de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} padres, y {{plural_you:saquen|sacad}} la impureza del lugar santo.
es.B: Les dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Escúchenme|Escuchadme}}, levitas! {{plural_you:Santifíquense|Santificaos}} ahora. Luego {{plural_you:santifiquen|santificad}} la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el Dios de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} antepasados, y {{plural_you:saquen|sacad}} del lugar santo todo lo impuro.
es.R: Les dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Escúchenme|Escuchadme}}, levitas! {{plural_you:Purifíquense|Purificaos}} ahora, y {{plural_you:purifiquen|purificad}} también el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el Dios de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} antepasados. {{plural_you:Tomen|Tomad}} todo lo que hace impuro el lugar santo, y {{plural_you:sáquenlo|sacadlo}}.

fr.L: Et il leur dit : « Écoutez-moi, Lévites ! Maintenant, consacrez-vous, et consacrez la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu de vos pères, et faites sortir l’impureté du lieu saint.
fr.B: Il leur dit : « Écoutez-moi, vous les Lévites ! Consacrez-vous maintenant. Puis consacrez la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu de vos ancêtres, et sortez du lieu saint tout ce qui est impur.
fr.R: Il leur a dit : « Écoutez-moi, Lévites ! Rendez-vous saints maintenant, et rendez saint aussi le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu de vos ancêtres. Prenez tout ce qui rend le lieu saint impur, et sortez-le.

sw.L: Akawaambia, "Nisikieni, Walawi! Sasa jitakaseni, mkaitakase nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa baba zenu, mkautoe uchafu kutoka patakatifu.
sw.B: Akawaambia, "Nisikilizeni, enyi Walawi! Jitakaseni sasa. Kisha itakaseni nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zenu, mkatoe nje kila kitu kichafu kutoka patakatifu.
sw.R: Akawaambia, "Nisikilizeni, Walawi! Jifanyeni kuwa watakatifu sasa, na mlifanye hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zenu, kuwa takatifu pia. Chukueni kila kitu kinachofanya mahali patakatifu kuwa najisi, mkakitoe nje.

vi.L: Vua nói với họ: "Hỡi người Lê-vi, hãy nghe ta! Bây giờ hãy thánh hóa chính mình, và thánh hóa nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ phụ các ngươi, và đem sự ô uế ra khỏi nơi thánh.
vi.B: Vua nói với họ: "Hỡi các người Lê-vi, hãy nghe ta! Bây giờ các con hãy thánh hóa chính mình. Rồi hãy thánh hóa nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên các con, và đem mọi vật ô uế ra khỏi nơi thánh.
vi.R: Vua nói với họ: "Hỡi người Lê-vi, hãy nghe ta! Bây giờ các con hãy làm cho mình nên thánh, và làm cho đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên các con, cũng nên thánh. Hãy đem hết mọi thứ làm ô uế nơi thánh ra ngoài.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그들에게 말했다. "레위인들아, 내 말을 들어라. 이제 너희 자신을 거룩하게 하고, 너희 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 거룩하게 하고, 성소에서 더러운 것을 내보내라.
ko.B: 그가 그들에게 말했다. "레위인들아, 내 말을 들어라! 이제 너희 자신을 거룩하게 하여라. 그리고 너희 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 거룩하게 하고, 성소에서 더러운 것을 모두 내다 버려라.
ko.R: 그가 그들에게 말했다. "레위인들아, 내 말을 들어라! 이제 너희 자신을 깨끗하고 거룩하게 하여라. 그리고 너희 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전도 거룩하게 하여라. 성소를 더럽히는 것은 모두 밖으로 내다 버려라.

decisions.choice: Levites: the whole tribe, priests included
decisions.reason: Hezekiah had called both priests and Levites (verse 4), and he speaks of duties that belonged to the priests alone, such as burning incense (verse 11; 26:18). Here "Levites" names the whole tribe of Levi, as it sometimes does (Deuteronomy 18:1).

decisions.choice: consecrate yourselves ... consecrate the house: two forms of one verb
decisions.reason: The first form means to make oneself holy: to wash, keep from what defiles and be ready for holy service (Exodus 19:22; 1 Chronicles 15:12). The second means to make something holy: to set the house apart again for God and make it fit for worship.

decisions.choice: the impurity: whatever defiled the sanctuary
decisions.reason: The word is used of a woman's monthly impurity (Leviticus 15:19), and from there of anything that makes a person or place unclean and must be put away (Ezra 9:11; Lamentations 1:17). Here it means the idols, altars and refuse that had been brought in or left to lie while the temple was shut (28:24; 2 Kings 16:10-18).

decisions.choice: the holy place: the sanctuary as a whole
decisions.reason: The word can name the outer room of the temple, but here it stands for the whole sanctuary, as the work of verses 16-17 shows.

decisions.choice: the God of your ancestors
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "ancestors" for "fathers" when the word means forefathers, as 2 Chronicles 15:12 does; Literal keeps "fathers".

decisions.choice: make yourselves holy; make ... holy
decisions.reason: Readable says what "consecrate" means in plain words, as 1 Chronicles 15:12 does.

decisions.choice: "santificarse ... santificar" (L, B); "purificarse ... purificar" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep one verb for the two forms of the Hebrew verb (m2); Readable says what consecrating means in plain words, as the English does. Hezekiah speaks to all the Levites, so every "you" is plural.

decisions.choice: "Rendez-vous saints ... rendez saint" (Readable); "consacrez" (Literal, Balanced)
decisions.reason: Readable says what "consecrate" means in everyday words, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: jitakaseni ... itakaseni
decisions.reason: "Kutakasa" (make holy, consecrate) is used for both the Levites and the house, so the two forms of one verb stay visible (m2); Readable says "jifanyeni kuwa watakatifu".

decisions.choice: Hezekiah says "ta" and calls the Levites "các ngươi" (L), "các con" (B, R)
decisions.reason: He calls them "my sons" in verse 11 (m1 there); Balanced and Readable use that warm word through the speech, Literal keeps the royal "các ngươi" until the Hebrew says "my sons".

decisions.choice: "thánh hóa" (L, B); "làm cho ... nên thánh" (R)
decisions.reason: One verb for consecrating people and the house (m2), kept at every level in this chapter.

decisions.choice: Hezekiah speaks to the priests and Levites in 해라체 ("들어라", "내 아들들아" in verse 11)
decisions.reason: A king gives orders to those who serve under him in the plain style, as in the Kings drafts; "my sons" (verse 11) is a warm address from the king.

source.text: כִּֽי־מָעֲל֣וּ אֲבֹתֵ֗ינוּ וְעָשׂ֥וּ הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה־אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ וַיַּֽעַזְבֻ֑הוּ וַיַּסֵּ֧בּוּ פְנֵיהֶ֛ם מִמִּשְׁכַּ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה וַיִּתְּנוּ־עֹֽרֶף׃

records.literal_gloss: For were unfaithful our fathers and did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh our God and forsook him, and turned their faces from [the] dwelling of Yahweh and gave [the] back of [the] neck.

en.L: For our fathers acted unfaithfully and did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, and they forsook {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. And they turned their faces away from the dwelling place of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and gave [it the] back of [the] neck.
en.B: Our fathers were unfaithful and did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God. They forsook {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; they turned their faces from the place where {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} dwells and showed it their backs.
en.R: Our fathers were not faithful to God. They did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God said was evil, and they left {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. They turned away from the place where {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives and turned their backs on it.

es.L: Porque nuestros padres fueron infieles e hicieron lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} abandonaron. Y apartaron sus rostros de la morada {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y [le] dieron la espalda.
es.B: Nuestros padres fueron infieles e hicieron lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios. Lo abandonaron; apartaron su rostro del lugar donde habita {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y le dieron la espalda.
es.R: Nuestros padres no fueron fieles a Dios. Hicieron lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios reprueba, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} dejaron. Se apartaron del lugar donde vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y le dieron la espalda.

fr.L: Car nos pères ont été infidèles et ont fait ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu, et ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont abandonné. Et ils ont détourné leur face de la demeure {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et [lui] ont tourné la nuque.
fr.B: Nos pères ont été infidèles et ont fait ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu. Ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont abandonné ; ils ont détourné le visage de la demeure {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et lui ont tourné le dos.
fr.R: Nos pères n’ont pas été fidèles à Dieu. Ils ont fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu déclare mauvais, et ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont abandonné. Ils se sont détournés de l’endroit où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} habite et ils lui ont tourné le dos.

sw.L: Kwa maana baba zetu walikosa uaminifu, wakafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, wakamwacha, wakageuza nyuso zao kutoka maskani ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakaipa kisogo.
sw.B: Baba zetu hawakuwa waaminifu, wakafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu. Walimwacha; waligeuza nyuso zao mbali na mahali {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anapokaa, wakapapa kisogo.
sw.R: Baba zetu hawakuwa waaminifu kwa Mungu. Walifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya, nao wakamwacha. Waligeuka mbali na mahali {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anapoishi, wakapapa kisogo.

vi.L: Vì tổ phụ chúng ta đã bất trung và làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, và lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Họ quay mặt khỏi nơi ngự của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và xoay gáy lại.
vi.B: Tổ phụ chúng ta đã bất trung và làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta. Họ lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, quay mặt khỏi nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngự và xoay lưng lại với nơi ấy.
vi.R: Tổ phụ chúng ta đã không trung tín với Đức Chúa Trời. Họ làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, cho là ác, và họ đã bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Họ quay đi khỏi nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngự và quay lưng lại với nơi ấy.

ko.L: 우리 조상들이 신의를 저버리고, 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 하고, 그분을 버렸다. 그리고 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 거하시는 곳에서 그들의 얼굴을 돌리고 [그곳에] 목덜미를 보였다.
ko.B: 우리 조상들은 신의를 저버리고, 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했다. 그들은 그분을 버리고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 계시는 곳에서 얼굴을 돌려 그곳에 등을 돌렸다.
ko.R: 우리 조상들은 하나님께 신실하지 못했다. 그들은 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 하고, 그분을 떠났다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 계시는 곳에서 얼굴을 돌리고 그곳에 등을 돌려 버렸다.

decisions.choice: were unfaithful: broke faith with God
decisions.reason: The verb means to break trust, to fail to give what is owed, often by taking what belongs to God or giving his worship to others. It is one of Chronicles' key words for sin (1 Chronicles 10:13; 2 Chronicles 26:16; 28:19, 22).

decisions.choice: our fathers: the generations just before, Ahaz's above all
decisions.reason: Hezekiah means the people of his father's day and before, who had seen the temple shut (28:22-25). Verse 9 speaks of these same fathers falling in battle.

decisions.choice: the dwelling: the temple as the place where Yahweh lives
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for the tabernacle in the wilderness, the tent where God dwelt among his people (Exodus 25:9). Here it names the temple that had taken its place.

decisions.choice: gave the back of the neck: turned their backs in contempt
decisions.reason: To show someone the back of the neck is to turn away from them on purpose and refuse to look at them (Jeremiah 2:27; 32:33). It is the opposite of turning the face toward God in prayer.

decisions.choice: our fathers
decisions.reason: Here "fathers" is kept at every level, since Hezekiah means recent generations, people his hearers knew, rather than distant ancestors.

decisions.choice: showed it their backs (Balanced); turned their backs on it (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the plain gesture of turning one's back. Literal keeps "gave [it the] back of [the] neck".

decisions.choice: "[le] dieron la espalda" (L); "le dieron la espalda" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Spanish has the same gesture of turning one's back in contempt, so every level says it (m4); Literal brackets the object.

decisions.choice: passé composé at every level in Hezekiah's speech
decisions.reason: Speech keeps the tenses of speech, as the style guide sets; the verdict formula takes the passé composé here ("ont fait ce qui est mal").

decisions.choice: wakaipa kisogo / wakapapa kisogo
decisions.reason: Swahili "kumpa mtu kisogo" (to give someone the back of the head) is the same gesture of contempt as the Hebrew, so it stands at every level.

decisions.choice: "tổ phụ chúng ta" at every level
decisions.reason: The English keeps "our fathers" at Balanced and Readable for the generations just before (m2); "tổ phụ" covers fathers and forefathers.

source.text: גַּ֣ם סָֽגְר֞וּ דַּלְת֣וֹת הָאוּלָ֗ם וַיְכַבּוּ֙ אֶת־הַנֵּר֔וֹת וּקְטֹ֖רֶת לֹ֣א הִקְטִ֑ירוּ וְעֹלָה֙ לֹא־הֶעֱל֣וּ בַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ לֵאלֹהֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Also they shut [the] doors of the porch and put out the lamps, and incense not they burned, and burnt offering not they offered up in the holy [place] to [the] God of Israel.

en.L: They also shut the doors of the porch and put out the lamps, and they did not burn incense, and they did not offer up burnt offering in the holy place to the God of Israel.
en.B: They even shut the doors of the porch and put out the lamps. They did not burn incense or offer burnt offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.
en.R: They even closed the doors of the temple porch and put out the lamps. They stopped burning incense and offering burnt offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.

es.L: También cerraron las puertas del pórtico y apagaron las lámparas, y no quemaron incienso, ni ofrecieron holocausto en el lugar santo al Dios de Israel.
es.B: Hasta cerraron las puertas del pórtico y apagaron las lámparas. No quemaron incienso ni ofrecieron holocaustos en el lugar santo al Dios de Israel.
es.R: Hasta cerraron las puertas del pórtico del templo y apagaron las lámparas. Dejaron de quemar incienso y de ofrecer holocaustos en el lugar santo al Dios de Israel.

fr.L: Ils ont aussi fermé les portes du portique et éteint les lampes, et ils n’ont pas brûlé d’encens, et ils n’ont pas offert d’holocauste dans le lieu saint au Dieu d’Israël.
fr.B: Ils ont même fermé les portes du portique et éteint les lampes. Ils n’ont plus brûlé d’encens ni offert d’holocaustes dans le lieu saint au Dieu d’Israël.
fr.R: Ils ont même fermé les portes du portique du temple et ils ont éteint les lampes. Ils ont arrêté de brûler de l’encens et d’offrir des holocaustes au Dieu d’Israël dans le lieu saint.

sw.L: Pia wakaifunga milango ya ukumbi, wakazima taa, wala hawakufukiza uvumba, wala hawakutoa sadaka ya kuteketezwa katika patakatifu kwa Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.B: Hata waliifunga milango ya ukumbi na kuzima taa. Hawakufukiza uvumba wala kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa katika patakatifu kwa Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.R: Hata walifunga milango ya ukumbi wa hekalu na kuzima taa. Waliacha kufukiza uvumba na kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa katika patakatifu kwa Mungu wa Israeli.

vi.L: Họ cũng đóng các cửa hiên cửa, tắt các đèn, không đốt hương và không dâng của lễ thiêu trong nơi thánh cho Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Họ còn đóng các cửa hiên cửa và tắt đèn. Họ không đốt hương, cũng không dâng của lễ thiêu trong nơi thánh cho Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Họ còn đóng các cửa ở hiên cửa đền thờ và tắt đèn. Họ thôi đốt hương và thôi dâng của lễ thiêu trong nơi thánh cho Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 또 그들이 현관 문들을 닫고, 등불들을 끄고, 이스라엘의 하나님께 성소에서 분향하지 않고 번제를 드리지 않았다.
ko.B: 그들은 현관 문들까지 닫고 등불들을 꺼 버렸다. 그들은 성소에서 이스라엘의 하나님께 분향하지도 않고 번제를 드리지도 않았다.
ko.R: 그들은 성전 현관의 문들까지 닫고 등불들을 꺼 버렸다. 그들은 성소에서 이스라엘의 하나님께 향을 피우고 번제를 드리는 일을 그만두었다.

decisions.choice: they shut the doors of the porch: the closing of the temple under Ahaz
decisions.reason: Chronicles has already told how Ahaz shut the doors of the house of Yahweh and set up altars of his own all over Jerusalem (28:24-25). Hezekiah's first act undoes it (verse 3).

decisions.choice: the lamps, the incense, the burnt offering: the daily service
decisions.reason: The lamps were to burn every night, incense was burned morning and evening, and a burnt offering was made every morning and evening (Exodus 27:20-21; 29:38-42; 30:7-8; 2 Chronicles 13:11). Stopping them meant that the regular worship of Yahweh had ceased.

decisions.choice: temple porch
decisions.reason: Readable says which porch is meant, as 2 Chronicles 8:12 does.

source.text: וַיְהִי֙ קֶ֣צֶף יְהוָ֔ה עַל־יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיִּתְּנֵ֤ם לְזַֽעֲוָה֙ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה וְלִשְׁרֵקָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר אַתֶּ֥ם רֹאִ֖ים בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And was [the] wrath of Yahweh on Judah and Jerusalem, and he made them into a terror, into a horror and into a hissing, as you [are] seeing with your eyes.

en.L: And the wrath of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made them a terror, a horror and a hissing, as you are seeing with your eyes.
en.B: So the wrath of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came upon Judah and Jerusalem, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made them an object of terror, horror and hissing, as you can see with your own eyes.
en.R: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} became angry with Judah and Jerusalem. He made them a sight that fills people with fear and shock, so that they whistle at it in scorn. You can see this with your own eyes.

es.L: Y la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estuvo sobre Judá y Jerusalén, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los hizo objeto de espanto, de horror y de burla, como {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:ven|veis}} con {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} ojos.
es.B: Por eso la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino sobre Judá y Jerusalén, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los hizo objeto de espanto, de horror y de burla, como {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} ver con {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} propios ojos.
es.R: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se enojó con Judá y Jerusalén. Hizo de ellos algo que llena a la gente de miedo y espanto, y que la hace silbar con desprecio. {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}} mismos lo {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} ver con {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} propios ojos.

fr.L: Et la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} a été sur Juda et Jérusalem, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a livrés à l’épouvante, à la désolation et aux sifflets, comme vous le voyez de vos yeux.
fr.B: Aussi la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est venue sur Juda et Jérusalem, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} en a fait un objet d’épouvante, de désolation et de moquerie, comme vous le voyez de vos propres yeux.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est mis en colère contre Juda et Jérusalem. Il en a fait un spectacle qui remplit les gens de peur et d’horreur, et ils sifflent en le voyant pour s’en moquer. Vous le voyez de vos propres yeux.

sw.L: Basi ghadhabu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikawa juu ya Yuda na Yerusalemu, naye akawafanya kuwa kitisho, na kioja, na kitu cha kuzomewa, kama mnavyoona kwa macho yenu.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo ghadhabu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikaja juu ya Yuda na Yerusalemu, naye akawafanya kuwa kitu cha kutisha, cha kushangaza na cha kuzomewa, kama mnavyoona kwa macho yenu wenyewe.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliikasirikia Yuda na Yerusalemu. Aliwafanya kuwa kitu kinachowajaza watu hofu na mshtuko, hata wanakipigia mluzi kwa dharau. Mnaweza kuona hili kwa macho yenu wenyewe.

vi.L: Cơn thịnh nộ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giáng trên Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho họ thành sự kinh hoàng, sự ghê sợ và trò huýt sáo, như các ngươi đang thấy tận mắt.
vi.B: Vì vậy cơn thịnh nộ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giáng trên Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho họ thành điều kinh hoàng, ghê sợ và bị người ta huýt sáo chê cười, như chính mắt các con đang thấy.
vi.R: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi giận với Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem. Ngài khiến họ thành một cảnh tượng làm người ta sợ hãi và bàng hoàng, đến nỗi người ta huýt sáo chê bai. Chính mắt các con đã thấy điều này.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 진노가 유다와 예루살렘 위에 [내렸고], 주께서 그들을 공포와 놀람과 비웃음거리가 되게 하셨다. 너희가 너희 눈으로 보고 있는 대로다.
ko.B: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 진노가 유다와 예루살렘에 내렸다. 주께서는 그들을 두려움과 놀람과 비웃음의 대상이 되게 하셨다. 너희가 너희 눈으로 보는 그대로다.
ko.R: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 유다와 예루살렘에 진노하셨다. 주께서는 그들을 사람들이 보고 두려워하고 놀라며 혀를 차고 비웃는 꼴이 되게 하셨다. 너희가 너희 눈으로 보고 있는 그대로다.

decisions.choice: a terror: the word read aloud
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text give a rare spelling of the word; the vowels and the margin give the usual form, the word used in Deuteronomy 28:25. The meaning is the same either way: something that makes those who see it tremble.

decisions.choice: a terror, a horror and a hissing: the language of the covenant curse
decisions.reason: These are the words of the curse Moses warned of (Deuteronomy 28:25, 37) and that the prophets used for what would come on Judah. The same words come together in Jeremiah 29:18 (compare Jeremiah 19:8; 25:9, 18). Hezekiah says the curse has already begun to fall.

decisions.choice: a hissing: the whistle people gave at a ruin
decisions.reason: Passers-by would whistle or hiss at the sight of a ruined place or people, in shock and scorn (1 Kings 9:8; Lamentations 2:15-16).

decisions.choice: a horror: a ruin that appalls those who see it
decisions.reason: The word joins the ideas of desolation and of the dismay it causes in those who see it.

decisions.choice: a sight that fills people with fear and shock, so that they whistle at it in scorn
decisions.reason: Readable explains the three words instead of listing them, and says what the hissing meant.

decisions.choice: "objeto de espanto, de horror y de burla" (L, B); "que la hace silbar con desprecio" (R)
decisions.reason: Spanish "burla" gives the sense of the hissing at a ruin at Literal and Balanced; Readable explains the whistle of scorn, as the English does (m3).

decisions.choice: "혀를 차고 비웃는" for the hissing
decisions.reason: Korean shows shock and scorn at a ruin by clicking the tongue, the gesture that carries what the Hebrew hiss meant (m3).

source.text: וְהִנֵּ֛ה נָפְל֥וּ אֲבוֹתֵ֖ינוּ בֶּחָ֑רֶב וּבָנֵ֨ינוּ וּבְנוֹתֵ֧ינוּ וְנָשֵׁ֛ינוּ בַּשְּׁבִ֖י עַל־זֹֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: And look, have fallen our fathers by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives [are] in captivity on this.

en.L: And look, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives [are] in captivity because of this.
en.B: Because of this our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons, our daughters and our wives are in captivity.
en.R: That is why our fathers were killed in battle and our sons, daughters and wives were taken away as prisoners.

es.L: Y he aquí, nuestros padres han caído a espada, y nuestros hijos y nuestras hijas y nuestras mujeres [están] en cautiverio por esto.
es.B: Por esto nuestros padres han caído a espada, y nuestros hijos, nuestras hijas y nuestras mujeres están en cautiverio.
es.R: Por eso nuestros padres murieron en batalla, y nuestros hijos, nuestras hijas y nuestras esposas fueron llevados como prisioneros.

fr.L: Et voici, nos pères sont tombés par l’épée, et nos fils, et nos filles, et nos femmes [sont] en captivité à cause de cela.
fr.B: C’est pour cela que nos pères sont tombés par l’épée, et que nos fils, nos filles et nos femmes sont en captivité.
fr.R: C’est pour cela que nos pères ont été tués à la guerre et que nos fils, nos filles et nos femmes ont été emmenés comme prisonniers.

sw.L: Na tazama, baba zetu wameanguka kwa upanga, na wana wetu na binti zetu na wake zetu [wako] utumwani kwa sababu ya hili.
sw.B: Kwa sababu ya hili baba zetu wameanguka kwa upanga, na wana wetu, binti zetu na wake zetu wako utumwani.
sw.R: Ndiyo sababu baba zetu waliuawa vitani, na wana wetu, binti zetu na wake zetu wakachukuliwa kuwa wafungwa.

vi.L: Kìa, tổ phụ chúng ta đã ngã chết bởi gươm, và các con trai, con gái và vợ chúng ta bị lưu đày vì điều này.
vi.B: Vì điều này mà tổ phụ chúng ta đã ngã chết bởi gươm, còn các con trai, con gái và vợ chúng ta bị bắt làm tù binh.
vi.R: Đó là lý do tổ phụ chúng ta bị giết ngoài chiến trường, còn con trai, con gái và vợ chúng ta bị bắt đi làm tù binh.

ko.L: 그리고 보아라, 이 때문에 우리 조상들이 칼에 쓰러졌고, 우리 아들들과 우리 딸들과 우리 아내들이 사로잡혀 있다.
ko.B: 이 때문에 우리 조상들이 칼에 쓰러졌고, 우리 아들들과 딸들과 아내들이 사로잡혀 갔다.
ko.R: 그래서 우리 조상들이 싸움터에서 죽었고, 우리 아들들과 딸들과 아내들이 포로로 끌려갔다.

decisions.choice: fallen by the sword ... in captivity: the defeats under Ahaz
decisions.reason: Under Ahaz, Aram and Israel killed many in Judah and carried off captives (28:5-8), though the captives taken to Samaria were sent back (28:9-15). The Edomites and Philistines also raided Judah and took prisoners (28:17-18). Some of those taken were still in captivity.

decisions.choice: because of this: because of the unfaithfulness of verses 6-7
decisions.reason: "This" points back to what the fathers did. The losses were the result of turning away from Yahweh, as verse 8 has said.

decisions.choice: Because of this ... (Balanced); That is why ... (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring "because of this" to the front, where it links the verse to what goes before, in place of the opening "look". Readable says "killed in battle" for "fallen by the sword".

source.text: עַתָּה֙ עִם־לְבָבִ֔י לִכְר֣וֹת בְּרִ֔ית לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְיָשֹׁ֥ב מִמֶּ֖נּוּ חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Now with my heart [it is] to cut a covenant with Yahweh, [the] God of Israel, and may turn from us [the] burning of his anger.

en.L: Now [it is] with my heart to make a covenant with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, so that the burning of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger may turn away from us.
en.B: I have now set my heart on making a covenant with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, in the hope that the heat of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger will turn away from us.
en.R: Now I have decided to make a covenant with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will no longer be angry with us.

es.L: Ahora [está] en mi corazón hacer un pacto con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, para que se aparte de nosotros el ardor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira.
es.B: Ahora me he propuesto en mi corazón hacer un pacto con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, con la esperanza de que el ardor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira se aparte de nosotros.
es.R: Ahora he decidido hacer un pacto con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel. Así {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ya no estará enojado con nosotros.

fr.L: Maintenant, [il est] dans mon cœur de conclure une alliance avec {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, afin que l’ardeur de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère se détourne de nous.
fr.B: J’ai maintenant à cœur de conclure une alliance avec {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, pour que l’ardeur de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère se détourne de nous.
fr.R: Maintenant, j’ai décidé de faire une alliance avec {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne sera plus en colère contre nous.

sw.L: Sasa [ni] moyoni mwangu kufanya agano na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, ili ukali wa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ugeuke mbali nasi.
sw.B: Sasa nimeazimu moyoni mwangu kufanya agano na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, kwa matumaini kwamba ukali wa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} utageuka mbali nasi.
sw.R: Sasa nimeamua kufanya agano na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli. Ndipo hatatukasirikia tena.

vi.L: Bây giờ, lòng ta muốn lập giao ước với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, để cơn giận phừng phừng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quay khỏi chúng ta.
vi.B: Bây giờ ta đã quyết lòng lập giao ước với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, mong cho cơn giận phừng phừng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quay khỏi chúng ta.
vi.R: Bây giờ ta đã quyết định lập giao ước với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên. Như vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không còn giận chúng ta nữa.

ko.L: 이제 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 언약을 맺는 것이 내 마음에 있으니, 그분의 맹렬한 진노가 우리에게서 떠나기를 [바란다].
ko.B: 이제 나는 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 언약을 맺기로 마음을 정했다. 그러면 그분의 맹렬한 진노가 우리에게서 떠날 것이다.
ko.R: 이제 나는 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 언약을 맺기로 결심했다. 그러면 그분께서 더 이상 우리에게 진노하지 않으실 것이다.

decisions.choice: with my heart: I intend, I have resolved
decisions.reason: The heart is the seat of thought and will. "It is with my heart" means that the speaker has made up his mind (1 Chronicles 22:7; 28:2).

decisions.choice: make a covenant: bind himself and the people by a solemn pledge
decisions.reason: Literally "cut a covenant", the usual Hebrew phrase. Here it is a pledge to return to Yahweh and keep faith with him, as under Asa and Jehoiada (15:12; 23:16).

decisions.choice: so that ... may turn away: the purpose and hope of the covenant
decisions.reason: The verb has the form of a wish. Hezekiah hopes that renewed loyalty will bring an end to the anger of verse 8.

decisions.choice: I have set my heart on (Balanced); I have decided; he will no longer be angry with us (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of the heart in a common English phrase for a firm intention (m1); Readable says what the idioms of the heart and of burning anger mean.

source.text: בָּנַ֕י עַתָּ֖ה אַל־תִּשָּׁל֑וּ כִּֽי־בָכֶ֞ם בָּחַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה לַעֲמֹ֤ד לְפָנָיו֙ לְשָׁ֣רְת֔וֹ וְלִהְי֥וֹת ל֖וֹ מְשָׁרְתִ֥ים וּמַקְטִרִֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: My sons, now do not be negligent, for you has chosen Yahweh to stand before him to serve him, and to be for him ministers and burning incense.

en.L: My sons, now do not be negligent, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has chosen you to stand before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, to serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ministers and burners of incense."
en.B: My sons, do not be negligent now, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has chosen you to stand before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ministers and to burn incense."
en.R: My sons, do not be careless now. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has chosen you to stand in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. You are to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants and burn incense to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."

es.L: Hijos míos, no {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} negligentes ahora, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los|os}} ha escogido a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para estar delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, para servir{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}, y para ser {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ministros y quemar incienso».
es.B: Hijos míos, no {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} negligentes ahora, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los|os}} ha escogido para estar delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y servir{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}, para ser {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ministros y quemar incienso».
es.R: Hijos míos, no {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} descuidados ahora. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los|os}} ha escogido para estar delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y servir{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}. {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}} {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} ser {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} servidores y quemar{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} incienso».

fr.L: Mes fils, maintenant ne soyez pas négligents, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a choisis pour vous tenir devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir, et pour être {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ministres et brûler l’encens. »
fr.B: Mes fils, ne soyez pas négligents maintenant, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a choisis pour vous tenir devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir, pour être {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ministres et brûler l’encens. »
fr.R: Mes fils, ne soyez pas paresseux maintenant. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a choisis pour vous tenir devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir. Vous devez être {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} brûler de l’encens. »

sw.L: Wanangu, sasa msilegee, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewachagua ninyi msimame mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kumtumikia, na kuwa wahudumu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na wafukizaji wa uvumba."
sw.B: Wanangu, msilegee sasa, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewachagua ninyi msimame mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na kumtumikia, mwe wahudumu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na kufukiza uvumba."
sw.R: Wanangu, msizembe sasa. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewachagua ninyi msimame mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na kumtumikia. Mnapaswa kuwa watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na kumfukizia uvumba."

vi.L: Hỡi các con ta, bây giờ đừng lơ là, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn các con để đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, làm những người hầu việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và đốt hương."
vi.B: Hỡi các con, bây giờ đừng lơ là, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn các con để đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, làm những người hầu việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và đốt hương."
vi.R: Hỡi các con, bây giờ đừng chểnh mảng. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn các con để đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Các con phải làm đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và đốt hương dâng lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."

ko.L: 내 아들들아, 이제 게을리하지 마라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희를 택하셔서 그분 앞에 서서 그분을 섬기고, 그분의 일꾼이 되어 분향하게 하셨기 때문이다."
ko.B: 내 아들들아, 이제 게을리하지 마라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희를 택하셔서 그분 앞에 서서 그분을 섬기게 하셨고, 그분을 섬기는 일꾼이 되어 분향하게 하셨다."
ko.R: 내 아들들아, 이제 게으름을 피우지 마라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희를 뽑으셔서 그분 앞에 서서 그분을 섬기게 하셨다. 너희는 그분의 일꾼이 되어 그분께 향을 피워야 한다."

decisions.choice: my sons: a warm address from one in authority
decisions.reason: Hezekiah was a young man (verse 1), and many of those he spoke to were older. "My sons" is the language of a leader or teacher who cares for those under him (1 Samuel 3:6; Proverbs 1:8).

decisions.choice: do not be negligent: do not hold back or grow slack
decisions.reason: The verb means to be at ease or careless. Hezekiah urges them not to delay or do the work half-heartedly.

decisions.choice: chosen to stand before him, to serve him and burn incense
decisions.reason: This is how the Law describes the tribe of Levi's calling (Deuteronomy 10:8; 18:5; 1 Chronicles 23:13). Burning incense belonged to the priests alone (26:18), so these words are meant for the priests among the Levites.

decisions.choice: servants
decisions.reason: Readable says "servants" for "ministers", the plainer word for those who serve in the temple.

source.text: וַיָּקֻ֣מוּ הַ֠לְוִיִּם מַ֣חַת בֶּן־עֲמָשַׂ֞י וְיוֹאֵ֣ל בֶּן־עֲזַרְיָהוּ֮ מִן־בְּנֵ֣י הַקְּהָתִי֒ וּמִן־בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י קִ֚ישׁ בֶּן־עַבְדִּ֔י וַעֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־יְהַלֶּלְאֵ֑ל וּמִן־הַגֵּ֣רְשֻׁנִּ֔י יוֹאָח֙ בֶּן־זִמָּ֔ה וְעֵ֖דֶן בֶּן־יוֹאָֽח׃

records.literal_gloss: And arose the Levites: Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah, from [the] sons of the Kohathite[s]; and from [the] sons of Merari: Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel; and from the Gershonite[s]: Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah;

en.L: And the Levites arose: Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah,
en.B: Then the Levites set to work: from the descendants of the Kohathites, Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah; from the descendants of Merari, Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel; from the Gershonites, Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah,
en.R: Then these Levites got up to do the work. From the clan of Kohath there were Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah. From the clan of Merari there were Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel. From the clan of Gershon there were Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah.

es.L: Entonces se levantaron los levitas: Mahat hijo de Amasai y Joel hijo de Azarías, de los hijos de los coatitas; y de los hijos de Merari, Cis hijo de Abdi y Azarías hijo de Jehalelel; y de los gersonitas, Joa hijo de Zima y Edén hijo de Joa;
es.B: Entonces los levitas se pusieron a trabajar: de los descendientes de los coatitas, Mahat hijo de Amasai y Joel hijo de Azarías; de los descendientes de Merari, Cis hijo de Abdi y Azarías hijo de Jehalelel; de los gersonitas, Joa hijo de Zima y Edén hijo de Joa;
es.R: Entonces estos levitas se levantaron para hacer el trabajo. Del clan de Coat estaban Mahat hijo de Amasai y Joel hijo de Azarías. Del clan de Merari estaban Cis hijo de Abdi y Azarías hijo de Jehalelel. Del clan de Gersón estaban Joa hijo de Zima y Edén hijo de Joa.

fr.L: Et les Lévites se levèrent : Mahath fils d’Amasaï et Joël fils d’Azaria, d’entre les fils des Kehathites ; et d’entre les fils de Merari, Qish fils d’Abdi et Azaria fils de Yehallélel ; et d’entre les Guershonites, Yoah fils de Zimma et Éden fils de Yoah ;
fr.B: Alors les Lévites se mirent à l’œuvre : parmi les descendants des Kehathites, Mahath, fils d’Amasaï, et Joël, fils d’Azaria ; parmi les descendants de Merari, Qish, fils d’Abdi, et Azaria, fils de Yehallélel ; parmi les Guershonites, Yoah, fils de Zimma, et Éden, fils de Yoah ;
fr.R: Alors ces Lévites se sont levés pour faire le travail. Du clan de Kehath, il y avait Mahath, fils d’Amasaï, et Joël, fils d’Azaria. Du clan de Merari, il y avait Qish, fils d’Abdi, et Azaria, fils de Yehallélel. Du clan de Guershon, il y avait Yoah, fils de Zimma, et Éden, fils de Yoah.

sw.L: Nao Walawi wakainuka: Mahathi mwana wa Amasai na Yoeli mwana wa Azaria, wa wana wa Wakohathi; na wa wana wa Merari, Kishi mwana wa Abdi na Azaria mwana wa Yehaleleli; na wa Wagershoni, Yoa mwana wa Zima na Edeni mwana wa Yoa,
sw.B: Kisha Walawi wakaanza kazi: kutoka kwa wazao wa Wakohathi, Mahathi mwana wa Amasai na Yoeli mwana wa Azaria; kutoka kwa wazao wa Merari, Kishi mwana wa Abdi na Azaria mwana wa Yehaleleli; kutoka kwa Wagershoni, Yoa mwana wa Zima na Edeni mwana wa Yoa;
sw.R: Kisha Walawi hawa wakainuka kufanya kazi. Kutoka ukoo wa Kohathi walikuwa Mahathi mwana wa Amasai na Yoeli mwana wa Azaria. Kutoka ukoo wa Merari walikuwa Kishi mwana wa Abdi na Azaria mwana wa Yehaleleli. Kutoka ukoo wa Gershoni walikuwa Yoa mwana wa Zima na Edeni mwana wa Yoa.

vi.L: Những người Lê-vi đứng dậy: Ma-hát con trai A-ma-sai và Giô-ên con trai A-xa-ria, thuộc con cháu Kê-hát; thuộc con cháu Mê-ra-ri: Kích con trai Áp-đi và A-xa-ria con trai Giê-ha-lê-le; thuộc dòng Ghẹt-sôn: Giô-a con trai Xim-ma và Ê-đen con trai Giô-a;
vi.B: Bấy giờ những người Lê-vi bắt tay vào việc: thuộc dòng dõi Kê-hát có Ma-hát con trai A-ma-sai và Giô-ên con trai A-xa-ria; thuộc dòng dõi Mê-ra-ri có Kích con trai Áp-đi và A-xa-ria con trai Giê-ha-lê-le; thuộc dòng Ghẹt-sôn có Giô-a con trai Xim-ma và Ê-đen con trai Giô-a;
vi.R: Bấy giờ những người Lê-vi sau đây đứng lên làm việc. Thuộc gia tộc Kê-hát có Ma-hát con trai A-ma-sai và Giô-ên con trai A-xa-ria. Thuộc gia tộc Mê-ra-ri có Kích con trai Áp-đi và A-xa-ria con trai Giê-ha-lê-le. Thuộc gia tộc Ghẹt-sôn có Giô-a con trai Xim-ma và Ê-đen con trai Giô-a.

ko.L: 그리고 레위인들이 일어났다. 그핫 자손 가운데서는 아마새의 아들 마핫과 아사랴의 아들 요엘이, 므라리 자손 가운데서는 압디의 아들 기스와 여할렐렐의 아들 아사랴가, 게르손 사람들 가운데서는 심마의 아들 요아와 요아의 아들 에덴이,
ko.B: 그러자 레위인들이 일을 시작했다. 그핫 자손 가운데서는 아마새의 아들 마핫과 아사랴의 아들 요엘, 므라리 자손 가운데서는 압디의 아들 기스와 여할렐렐의 아들 아사랴, 게르손 자손 가운데서는 심마의 아들 요아와 요아의 아들 에덴,
ko.R: 그러자 이 레위인들이 일어나 일을 시작했다. 그핫 집안에서는 아마새의 아들 마핫과 아사랴의 아들 요엘이 나섰다. 므라리 집안에서는 압디의 아들 기스와 여할렐렐의 아들 아사랴가 나섰다. 게르손 집안에서는 심마의 아들 요아와 요아의 아들 에덴이 나섰다.

decisions.choice: arose: set to work
decisions.reason: "Arise" often means to get up and begin to act (1 Chronicles 22:16).

decisions.choice: the three clans of Levi, then four more families
decisions.reason: The list begins with the three clans descended from Levi's sons Kohath, Merari and Gershon (Numbers 3:17; 1 Chronicles 23:6). Verses 13-14 add the family of Elizaphan, and the families of the three singers Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun. Two men are named from each of the seven groups.

decisions.choice: the men named: leaders of their families in Hezekiah's day
decisions.reason: Several of these names occur in earlier Levite family lists (Mahath, Amasai and Joel in 1 Chronicles 6:20-21; Zimmah and Joah in 6:5-6), since families reused names. The men here are later members of those lines.

decisions.choice: set to work
decisions.reason: Balanced says what their rising meant. Literal keeps "arose".

decisions.choice: the clan of Kohath, of Merari, of Gershon
decisions.reason: Readable names each clan by its ancestor, as 1 Chronicles 15:5 does, and makes each group its own sentence.

decisions.choice: "los coatitas", "Merari", "los gersonitas" (L, B); "el clan de Coat, de Merari, de Gersón" (R)
decisions.reason: The three clans of Levi in their usual Spanish forms, after Coat, Merari and Gersón of the published Pentateuch; the men's names in their usual Spanish forms (Mahat, Amasai, Cis, Abdi, Jehalelel, Joa, Zima, Edén).

decisions.choice: "Kehathites", "Merari", "Guershonites"
decisions.reason: The French forms of the Pentateuch (Kehath, Merari, Guershon); the men's names are in the French forms of these books.

decisions.choice: Each clan named before its men ("그핫 자손 가운데서는 ...")
decisions.reason: Korean puts the group before the people chosen from it; the list runs on into verses 13-14 at Literal and Balanced as the Hebrew does, and Readable gives each group its own sentence.

source.text: וּמִן־בְּנֵי֙ אֱלִ֣יצָפָ֔ן שִׁמְרִ֖י וִיעִיאֵ֑ל וּמִן־בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֔ף זְכַרְיָ֖הוּ וּמַתַּנְיָֽהוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: and from [the] sons of Elizaphan: Shimri and Jeiel; and from [the] sons of Asaph: Zechariah and Mattaniah;

en.L: and of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeiel; and of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah,
en.B: from the descendants of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeiel; from the descendants of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah,
en.R: From the family of Elizaphan there were Shimri and Jeiel. From the family of Asaph there were Zechariah and Mattaniah.

es.L: y de los hijos de Elizafán, Simri y Jeiel; y de los hijos de Asaf, Zacarías y Matanías;
es.B: de los descendientes de Elizafán, Simri y Jeiel; de los descendientes de Asaf, Zacarías y Matanías;
es.R: De la familia de Elizafán estaban Simri y Jeiel. De la familia de Asaf estaban Zacarías y Matanías.

fr.L: et d’entre les fils d’Élitsaphân, Shimri et Yeïel ; et d’entre les fils d’Asaph, Zacharie et Mattania ;
fr.B: parmi les descendants d’Élitsaphân, Shimri et Yeïel ; parmi les descendants d’Asaph, Zacharie et Mattania ;
fr.R: De la famille d’Élitsaphân, il y avait Shimri et Yeïel. De la famille d’Asaph, il y avait Zacharie et Mattania.

sw.L: na wa wana wa Elisafani, Shimri na Yeieli; na wa wana wa Asafu, Zekaria na Matania,
sw.B: kutoka kwa wazao wa Elisafani, Shimri na Yeieli; kutoka kwa wazao wa Asafu, Zekaria na Matania;
sw.R: Kutoka jamaa ya Elisafani walikuwa Shimri na Yeieli. Kutoka jamaa ya Asafu walikuwa Zekaria na Matania.

vi.L: thuộc con cháu Ê-li-xa-phan: Sim-ri và Giê-i-ên; thuộc con cháu A-sáp: Xa-cha-ri và Mát-ta-nia;
vi.B: thuộc dòng dõi Ê-li-xa-phan có Sim-ri và Giê-i-ên; thuộc dòng dõi A-sáp có Xa-cha-ri và Mát-ta-nia;
vi.R: Thuộc gia đình Ê-li-xa-phan có Sim-ri và Giê-i-ên. Thuộc gia đình A-sáp có Xa-cha-ri và Mát-ta-nia.

ko.L: 엘리사반 자손 가운데서는 시므리와 여이엘이, 아삽 자손 가운데서는 스가랴와 맛다냐가,
ko.B: 엘리사반 자손 가운데서는 시므리와 여이엘, 아삽 자손 가운데서는 스가랴와 맛다냐,
ko.R: 엘리사반 집안에서는 시므리와 여이엘이 나섰다. 아삽 집안에서는 스가랴와 맛다냐가 나섰다.

decisions.choice: Elizaphan: the head of a leading Kohathite family
decisions.reason: Elizaphan was the leader of the Kohathite clans in the wilderness (Numbers 3:30). By David's time his descendants were counted as a family of their own (1 Chronicles 15:8), and so they are here.

decisions.choice: Jeiel: the name as read aloud
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text spell the name Jeuel; the vowels and the margin give Jeiel, the reading followed here. Both are forms found among Levite names (1 Chronicles 9:6; 15:18).

decisions.choice: Asaph: the family of one of David's chief singers
decisions.reason: Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun led the music David set up for worship (1 Chronicles 15:17; 25:1). Their descendants formed the singers' families, and they too took part in the cleansing.

decisions.choice: From the family of
decisions.reason: Readable says "family" for "sons" here, since these are smaller family lines inside the clan of Kohath and the singers' guilds, and makes each group its own sentence.

source.text: וּמִן־בְּנֵ֥י הֵימָ֖ן יְחִיאֵ֣ל וְשִׁמְעִ֑יסוּמִן־בְּנֵ֣י יְדוּת֔וּן שְׁמַֽעְיָ֖ה וְעֻזִּיאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: and from [the] sons of Heman: Jehiel and Shimei; and from [the] sons of Jeduthun: Shemaiah and Uzziel.

en.L: and of the sons of Heman, Jehiel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
en.B: from the descendants of Heman, Jehiel and Shimei; and from the descendants of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
en.R: From the family of Heman there were Jehiel and Shimei. And from the family of Jeduthun there were Shemaiah and Uzziel.

es.L: y de los hijos de Hemán, Jehiel y Simei; y de los hijos de Jedutún, Semaías y Uziel.
es.B: de los descendientes de Hemán, Jehiel y Simei; y de los descendientes de Jedutún, Semaías y Uziel.
es.R: De la familia de Hemán estaban Jehiel y Simei. Y de la familia de Jedutún estaban Semaías y Uziel.

fr.L: et d’entre les fils d’Hémân, Yehiel et Shiméï ; et d’entre les fils de Yedoutoun, Shemaya et Ouzziel.
fr.B: parmi les descendants d’Hémân, Yehiel et Shiméï ; et parmi les descendants de Yedoutoun, Shemaya et Ouzziel.
fr.R: De la famille d’Hémân, il y avait Yehiel et Shiméï. Et de la famille de Yedoutoun, il y avait Shemaya et Ouzziel.

sw.L: na wa wana wa Hemani, Yehieli na Shimei; na wa wana wa Yeduthuni, Shemaya na Uzieli.
sw.B: kutoka kwa wazao wa Hemani, Yehieli na Shimei; na kutoka kwa wazao wa Yeduthuni, Shemaya na Uzieli.
sw.R: Kutoka jamaa ya Hemani walikuwa Yehieli na Shimei. Na kutoka jamaa ya Yeduthuni walikuwa Shemaya na Uzieli.

vi.L: thuộc con cháu Hê-man: Giê-hi-ên và Si-mê-i; thuộc con cháu Giê-đu-thun: Sê-ma-gia và U-xi-ên.
vi.B: thuộc dòng dõi Hê-man có Giê-hi-ên và Si-mê-i; thuộc dòng dõi Giê-đu-thun có Sê-ma-gia và U-xi-ên.
vi.R: Thuộc gia đình Hê-man có Giê-hi-ên và Si-mê-i. Thuộc gia đình Giê-đu-thun có Sê-ma-gia và U-xi-ên.

ko.L: 헤만 자손 가운데서는 여히엘과 시므이가, 여두둔 자손 가운데서는 스마야와 웃시엘이 [일어났다].
ko.B: 헤만 자손 가운데서는 여히엘과 시므이, 여두둔 자손 가운데서는 스마야와 웃시엘이 일을 시작했다.
ko.R: 헤만 집안에서는 여히엘과 시므이가 나섰다. 그리고 여두둔 집안에서는 스마야와 웃시엘이 나섰다.

decisions.choice: Jehiel: the name as read aloud
decisions.reason: As with Jeiel in verse 13, the written consonants give a slightly different form of the name (Jehuel); the vowels and the margin give Jehiel, which is followed here.

decisions.choice: Heman and Jeduthun: the other two singers' families
decisions.reason: With Asaph (verse 13), these are the three families of temple musicians set up under David (1 Chronicles 25:1-6). The list of fourteen men ends here.

decisions.choice: From the family of
decisions.reason: As in verse 13.

decisions.choice: "Hemán", "Jedutún"
decisions.reason: The singers' names as published Spanish Psalm titles write them.

source.text: וַיַּֽאַסְפ֤וּ אֶת־אֲחֵיהֶם֙ וַיִּֽתְקַדְּשׁ֔וּ וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ כְמִצְוַת־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּדִבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לְטַהֵ֖ר בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they gathered their brothers and consecrated themselves and came, according to [the] command of the king, in [the] words of Yahweh, to cleanse [the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: And they gathered their brothers and consecrated themselves, and they came, according to the command of the king, by the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to cleanse the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: They gathered their relatives and consecrated themselves, and they came to cleanse the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as the king had commanded by the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: They gathered the other Levites, and they all made themselves holy. Then they went in to make the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} clean, as the king had commanded. His command followed the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y reunieron a sus hermanos y se santificaron, y vinieron, conforme al mandato del rey, por las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para purificar la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Reunieron a sus parientes y se santificaron, y vinieron a purificar la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como el rey había mandado conforme a las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Reunieron a los demás levitas, y todos se purificaron. Luego entraron a purificar el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como el rey había mandado. Su orden seguía las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et ils rassemblèrent leurs frères et se consacrèrent, et ils vinrent, selon l’ordre du roi, d’après les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, pour purifier la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ils rassemblèrent leurs frères et se consacrèrent, puis ils vinrent purifier la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme le roi l’avait ordonné d’après les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ils ont réuni les autres Lévites, et ils se sont tous rendus saints. Puis ils sont entrés pour purifier le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme le roi l’avait ordonné. Son ordre suivait les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Wakawakusanya ndugu zao, wakajitakasa, wakaja, sawasawa na amri ya mfalme, kwa maneno ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili kuitakasa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Waliwakusanya jamaa zao, wakajitakasa, wakaja kuitakasa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama mfalme alivyoamuru kwa maneno ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Waliwakusanya Walawi wengine, nao wote wakajifanya kuwa watakatifu. Kisha wakaingia kulisafisha hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama mfalme alivyoamuru. Amri yake ilifuata maneno ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Họ nhóm anh em mình lại, thánh hóa chính mình, rồi đến theo lệnh vua, theo lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, để tẩy sạch nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Họ nhóm anh em mình lại và thánh hóa chính mình, rồi đến tẩy sạch nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, như vua đã truyền theo lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Họ tập họp những người Lê-vi khác, và tất cả đều làm cho mình nên thánh. Rồi họ vào làm sạch đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, như vua đã truyền. Lệnh của vua phù hợp với lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그들의 형제들을 모으고 자기들을 거룩하게 한 뒤에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀에 따른 왕의 명령대로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 깨끗하게 하려고 왔다.
ko.B: 그들은 친족들을 모으고 자신들을 거룩하게 한 뒤에, 왕이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀에 따라 명령한 대로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 깨끗하게 하려고 들어갔다.
ko.R: 그들은 다른 레위인들을 모았고, 모두 자신들을 거룩하게 했다. 그런 다음 왕이 명령한 대로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전을 깨끗하게 하려고 들어갔다. 왕의 명령은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 따른 것이었다.

decisions.choice: their brothers: their fellow Levites
decisions.reason: "Brothers" here means the other members of their tribe, whom the fourteen leaders called together for the work.

decisions.choice: by the words of Yahweh: the king's command agreed with what Yahweh had said
alternatives: the king's order was given at Yahweh's word, through a prophet
decisions.reason: The phrase most likely means that Hezekiah's order followed the Law, which says the sanctuary must be kept clean and holy. It could also mean that the order itself came through a word from Yahweh, given by a prophet (compare 30:12).

decisions.choice: to cleanse: to make ritually clean
decisions.reason: The verb means to remove whatever makes a person or place unfit for God's presence (Leviticus 16:19). Here it means clearing out everything unclean and making the house fit for worship again.

decisions.choice: relatives (Balanced); the other Levites (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "relatives" for "brothers", as 1 Chronicles 15 does; Readable says who they were.

decisions.choice: His command followed the words of the LORD.
decisions.reason: Readable makes a separate sentence of the phrase, so that the link between the king's order and Yahweh's words is clear.

decisions.choice: "leurs frères" at Balanced
decisions.reason: For fellow Levites French "frères" is natural, where the English Balanced says "relatives".

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ הַ֠כֹּהֲנִים לִפְנִ֣ימָה בֵית־יְהוָה֮ לְטַהֵר֒ וַיּוֹצִ֗יאוּ אֵ֤ת כָּל־הַטֻּמְאָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָֽצְאוּ֙ בְּהֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה לַחֲצַ֖ר בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַֽיְקַבְּלוּ֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לְהוֹצִ֥יא לְנַֽחַל־קִדְר֖וֹן חֽוּצָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And went the priests to [the] inside of [the] house of Yahweh to cleanse, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in [the] temple of Yahweh to [the] court of [the] house of Yahweh; and received [it] the Levites to bring [it] out to [the] wadi of Kidron outside.

en.L: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to cleanse [it], and they brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to the court of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. And the Levites received [it] to take [it] out to the Wadi Kidron outside.
en.B: The priests entered the inner part of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house to cleanse it. Everything unclean that they found in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} they brought out into the court of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house, and the Levites took it from them and carried it outside to the Kidron Valley.
en.R: The priests went into the inner rooms of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house to make it clean. They brought everything unclean that they found in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple out into the courtyard of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house. Then the Levites took it and carried it out of the city to the Kidron Valley.

es.L: Y los sacerdotes entraron en el interior de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para purificar[la], y sacaron toda la inmundicia que hallaron en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} al atrio de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; y los levitas [la] tomaron para sacar[la] fuera, al torrente del Cedrón.
es.B: Los sacerdotes entraron en la parte interior de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para purificarla. Todo lo impuro que encontraron en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} lo sacaron al atrio de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y los levitas lo recogieron y lo llevaron fuera, al valle del Cedrón.
es.R: Los sacerdotes entraron en las salas interiores de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para purificarla. Sacaron al atrio de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} todo lo impuro que encontraron en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Luego los levitas lo recogieron y lo llevaron fuera de la ciudad, al valle del Cedrón.

fr.L: Et les prêtres entrèrent à l’intérieur de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pour [la] purifier, et ils sortirent toute l’impureté qu’ils trouvèrent dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} vers la cour de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Et les Lévites [la] reçurent pour [la] porter dehors, au torrent du Cédron.
fr.B: Les prêtres entrèrent à l’intérieur de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pour la purifier. Tout ce qu’ils trouvèrent d’impur dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, ils le sortirent dans la cour de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et les Lévites le prirent et l’emportèrent dehors, dans la vallée du Cédron.
fr.R: Les prêtres sont entrés dans les pièces intérieures de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pour la purifier. Ils ont sorti dans la cour de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} tout ce qu’ils ont trouvé d’impur dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Ensuite les Lévites l’ont pris et ils l’ont emporté hors de la ville, dans la vallée du Cédron.

sw.L: Makuhani wakaingia ndani ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ili kuitakasa, wakatoa uchafu wote walioukuta katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mpaka ua wa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nao Walawi wakaupokea ili kuutoa nje mpaka bonde la Kidroni.
sw.B: Makuhani waliingia sehemu ya ndani ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ili kuitakasa. Kila kitu kichafu walichokikuta katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} walikitoa nje mpaka ua wa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nao Walawi wakakipokea, wakakipeleka nje mpaka Bonde la Kidroni.
sw.R: Makuhani waliingia vyumba vya ndani vya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ili kuisafisha. Walitoa kila kitu kichafu walichokikuta katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakakileta nje uwanjani mwa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kisha Walawi wakakichukua, wakakipeleka nje ya mji mpaka Bonde la Kidroni.

vi.L: Các thầy tế lễ vào bên trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để tẩy sạch [nó], và đem mọi thứ ô uế họ tìm thấy trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ra sân nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; rồi người Lê-vi nhận lấy để đem ra ngoài, đến khe Xết-rôn.
vi.B: Các thầy tế lễ vào phần bên trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để tẩy sạch. Họ đem mọi vật ô uế tìm thấy trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ra sân nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, rồi người Lê-vi nhận lấy và đem ra ngoài, đến thung lũng Xết-rôn.
vi.R: Các thầy tế lễ vào các phòng bên trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để làm sạch. Họ đem mọi vật ô uế tìm thấy trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ra sân nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Rồi người Lê-vi nhận lấy và đem ra khỏi thành, đến thung lũng Xết-rôn.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 안쪽으로 들어가서 [그곳을] 깨끗하게 하고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 찾아낸 더러운 것을 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 뜰로 내왔다. 그리고 레위인들이 [그것을] 받아 밖으로 기드론 시내로 가져갔다.
ko.B: 제사장들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 안쪽으로 들어가 그곳을 깨끗하게 했다. 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 찾아낸 더러운 것을 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 뜰로 내오면, 레위인들이 그것을 받아 밖에 있는 기드론 골짜기로 가져갔다.
ko.R: 제사장들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 안쪽 방들로 들어가 그곳을 깨끗하게 했다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 찾아낸 더러운 것을 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 뜰로 내왔다. 그러면 레위인들이 그것을 받아 성 밖에 있는 기드론 골짜기로 가져갔다.

decisions.choice: the priests went inside; the Levites carried things away
decisions.reason: Only the priests could enter the temple building itself (Numbers 18:3, 7). So they brought everything out into the court, and the Levites, who could work in the courts, took it from there.

decisions.choice: the temple: the main building of the house of Yahweh
decisions.reason: This word names the temple building, or its main hall, as distinct from the courts around it.

decisions.choice: the uncleanness: everything that made the place unclean
decisions.reason: The word covers whatever defiled the sanctuary, including idols and objects used in other worship, as in verse 5.

decisions.choice: the Wadi Kidron: the valley east of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The Kidron lies between the city and the Mount of Olives. Its streambed was dry for most of the year. Asa had burned Maacah's idol there (15:16), and Josiah would do the same with the objects of Baal worship (2 Kings 23:4, 6; compare 2 Chronicles 30:14).

decisions.choice: out of the city
decisions.reason: Readable says what "outside" means: outside the city, where the Kidron Valley lies.

decisions.choice: "el torrente del Cedrón" (L); "el valle del Cedrón" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Kidron as the terms note names it; Literal keeps the Hebrew word for a stream bed, Balanced and Readable say "valle", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "le torrent du Cédron" (Literal); "la vallée du Cédron" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: A wadi is "torrent" at Literal, as in French Kings; Balanced and Readable follow the English "Kidron Valley".

decisions.choice: "khe Xết-rôn" (L); "thung lũng Xết-rôn" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The 2 Kings drafts' wording for the Wadi Kidron (m4).

source.text: וַ֠יָּחֵלּוּ בְּאֶחָ֞ד לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן֮ לְקַדֵּשׁ֒ וּבְי֧וֹם שְׁמוֹנָ֣ה לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ בָּ֚אוּ לְאוּלָ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה וַיְקַדְּשׁ֥וּ אֶת־בֵּית־יְהוָ֖ה לְיָמִ֣ים שְׁמוֹנָ֑ה וּבְי֨וֹם שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן כִּלּֽוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And they began on [the] first of the month the first to consecrate, and on day eight of the month they came to [the] porch of Yahweh, and they consecrated [the] house of Yahweh in days eight, and on day sixteen of the month the first they finished.

en.L: And they began on the first [day] of the first month to consecrate, and on the eighth day of the month they came to the porch of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and they consecrated the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.
en.B: The consecration began on the first day of the first month, and by the eighth day of the month they had come as far as the porch of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Then for eight days they consecrated the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.
en.R: They started this work on the first day of the first month. By the eighth day of the month they had reached the porch of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple. Then they spent eight more days making {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house holy, and they finished on the sixteenth day of the first month.

es.L: Y comenzaron a santificar el primero del mes primero, y el día octavo del mes llegaron al pórtico {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; y santificaron la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en ocho días, y el día dieciséis del mes primero terminaron.
es.B: La consagración comenzó el primer día del mes primero, y para el día octavo del mes ya habían llegado al pórtico {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Después santificaron la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} durante ocho días, y el día dieciséis del mes primero terminaron.
es.R: Comenzaron este trabajo el primer día del mes primero. Para el día octavo del mes ya habían llegado al pórtico del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Luego dedicaron ocho días más a purificar la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y terminaron el día dieciséis del mes primero.
