decisions.reason: "Holy things" here are the sacrifices and thank offerings of verse 31, as distinct from the burnt offerings counted in verse 32. Part of them was burned on the altar, and the rest was eaten by the worshipers and priests (compare 35:13).

decisions.choice: sheep: animals from the flock
decisions.reason: The word means a flock of small animals and can include goats.

decisions.choice: consecrated offerings (Balanced); the other offerings set apart for God (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced says what kind of holy things are meant. Readable explains "consecrated" and sets them beside the burnt offerings of verse 32.

source.text: רַ֤ק הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ הָי֣וּ לִמְעָ֔ט וְלֹ֣א יָֽכְל֔וּ לְהַפְשִׁ֖יט אֶת־כָּל־הָעֹל֑וֹת וַֽיְּחַזְּק֞וּם אֲחֵיהֶ֣ם הַלְוִיִּ֗ם עַד־כְּל֤וֹת הַמְּלָאכָה֙ וְעַ֣ד יִתְקַדְּשׁ֣וּ הַכֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים כִּ֤י הַלְוִיִּם֙ יִשְׁרֵ֣י לֵבָ֔ב לְהִתְקַדֵּ֖שׁ מֵֽהַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Only the priests were to fewness, and not they were able to skin all the burnt offerings; and helped them their brothers the Levites until [the] finishing of the work and until consecrated themselves the priests, for the Levites [were] more upright of heart to consecrate themselves than the priests.

en.L: But the priests were too few, and they were not able to skin all the burnt offerings; so their brothers the Levites helped them until the work was finished and until the priests had consecrated themselves, for the Levites [were] more upright of heart to consecrate themselves than the priests.
en.B: But the priests were too few to skin all the burnt offerings. So their relatives the Levites helped them until the task was done and the priests had consecrated themselves, for the Levites were more upright in heart to consecrate themselves than the priests.
en.R: But there were not enough priests to skin all the animals for the burnt offerings. So their relatives the Levites helped them until the work was done and until more priests had made themselves holy. The Levites had been more careful than the priests to make themselves holy.

es.L: Pero los sacerdotes eran pocos, y no podían desollar todos los holocaustos; así que sus hermanos los levitas los ayudaron hasta que se acabó la obra y hasta que los sacerdotes se santificaron, porque los levitas [fueron] más rectos de corazón para santificarse que los sacerdotes.
es.B: Pero los sacerdotes eran muy pocos para desollar todos los holocaustos. Por eso sus parientes los levitas los ayudaron hasta que se terminó la tarea y los sacerdotes se santificaron, porque los levitas habían sido más rectos de corazón para santificarse que los sacerdotes.
es.R: Pero no había suficientes sacerdotes para quitarles la piel a todos los animales de los holocaustos. Por eso sus parientes los levitas los ayudaron hasta que se terminó el trabajo y hasta que más sacerdotes se purificaron. Los levitas habían tenido más cuidado que los sacerdotes en purificarse.

fr.L: Seulement, les prêtres étaient trop peu nombreux, et ils ne purent pas dépouiller tous les holocaustes ; alors leurs frères les Lévites les aidèrent jusqu’à ce que l’ouvrage fût achevé et jusqu’à ce que les prêtres se fussent consacrés, car les Lévites [avaient] le cœur plus droit pour se consacrer que les prêtres.
fr.B: Mais les prêtres étaient trop peu nombreux pour dépouiller tous les holocaustes. Leurs frères les Lévites les aidèrent donc jusqu’à ce que le travail soit achevé et que les prêtres se soient consacrés, car les Lévites avaient mis plus de droiture de cœur à se consacrer que les prêtres.
fr.R: Mais il n’y avait pas assez de prêtres pour enlever la peau de tous les animaux offerts en holocaustes. Alors leurs frères les Lévites les ont aidés jusqu’à la fin du travail et jusqu’à ce que d’autres prêtres se soient rendus saints. Les Lévites avaient été plus attentifs que les prêtres à se rendre saints.

sw.L: Lakini makuhani walikuwa wachache, wala hawakuweza kuchuna ngozi sadaka zote za kuteketezwa; kwa hiyo ndugu zao Walawi wakawasaidia mpaka kazi ilipokwisha na mpaka makuhani walipojitakasa, kwa maana Walawi [walikuwa] wanyofu zaidi wa moyo kujitakasa kuliko makuhani.
sw.B: Lakini makuhani walikuwa wachache mno kuweza kuchuna ngozi sadaka zote za kuteketezwa. Kwa hiyo jamaa zao Walawi waliwasaidia mpaka kazi ilipokwisha na makuhani walipokwisha kujitakasa, kwa sababu Walawi walikuwa wanyofu zaidi wa moyo katika kujitakasa kuliko makuhani.
sw.R: Lakini makuhani hawakutosha kuchuna ngozi wanyama wote wa sadaka za kuteketezwa. Kwa hiyo jamaa zao Walawi waliwasaidia mpaka kazi ilipokwisha na mpaka makuhani wengine walipojitakasa. Walawi walikuwa wamejali zaidi kuliko makuhani kujifanya kuwa watakatifu.

vi.L: Nhưng các thầy tế lễ quá ít, không thể lột da hết các của lễ thiêu; vì vậy anh em họ là người Lê-vi giúp họ cho đến khi công việc xong và cho đến khi các thầy tế lễ đã thánh hóa chính mình, vì người Lê-vi có lòng ngay thẳng để thánh hóa chính mình hơn các thầy tế lễ.
vi.B: Nhưng các thầy tế lễ quá ít, không lột da hết các của lễ thiêu được. Vì vậy anh em họ là người Lê-vi giúp họ cho đến khi xong việc và cho đến khi các thầy tế lễ đã thánh hóa chính mình, vì người Lê-vi có lòng ngay thẳng trong việc thánh hóa chính mình hơn các thầy tế lễ.
vi.R: Nhưng không có đủ thầy tế lễ để lột da hết các con vật dâng làm của lễ thiêu. Vì vậy anh em họ là người Lê-vi giúp họ cho đến khi xong việc, và cho đến khi có thêm thầy tế lễ đã làm cho mình nên thánh. Người Lê-vi đã cẩn thận làm cho mình nên thánh hơn các thầy tế lễ.

ko.L: 다만 제사장들이 수가 적어서 번제물의 가죽을 다 벗길 수 없었다. 그래서 그들의 형제 레위인들이 일이 끝날 때까지, 그리고 제사장들이 자신을 거룩하게 할 때까지 그들을 도왔다. 레위인들이 자신을 거룩하게 하는 데에 제사장들보다 마음이 더 정직했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러나 제사장들의 수가 너무 적어서 번제물의 가죽을 다 벗길 수 없었다. 그래서 그들의 친족인 레위인들이 일이 끝날 때까지, 그리고 제사장들이 자신을 거룩하게 할 때까지 그들을 도왔다. 레위인들이 자신을 거룩하게 하는 일에 제사장들보다 더 성실했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그러나 번제로 드릴 짐승들의 가죽을 다 벗기기에는 제사장들이 너무 모자랐다. 그래서 그들의 친족인 레위인들이 일이 다 끝날 때까지, 그리고 더 많은 제사장들이 자신을 거룩하게 할 때까지 그들을 도왔다. 레위인들은 제사장들보다 더 정성껏 자신을 거룩하게 했기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: to skin the burnt offerings
decisions.reason: The hide of a burnt offering was removed before it was cut up and burned (Leviticus 1:6). With so many animals, and few priests ready, the Levites were needed to help (compare 35:11).

decisions.choice: more upright of heart: more earnest and conscientious
decisions.reason: An "upright heart" is one that is honest and set on doing what is right (Psalm 7:11; 32:11). The Levites had been quicker and more careful to make themselves ready than many of the priests.

decisions.choice: until the priests had consecrated themselves: until more priests were ready
decisions.reason: Not enough priests had yet made themselves holy for the work, and the same shortage held up the Passover (30:3). The Levites helped until enough priests were ready.

decisions.choice: relatives
decisions.reason: As in verse 15.

decisions.choice: more priests; more careful
decisions.reason: Readable says "more priests" to make clear that some priests were not yet ready (meaning note 3), and "more careful" for "more upright of heart".

source.text: וְגַם־עֹלָ֨ה לָרֹ֜ב בְּחֶלְבֵ֧י הַשְּׁלָמִ֛ים וּבַנְּסָכִ֖ים לָעֹלָ֑ה וַתִּכּ֖וֹן עֲבוֹדַ֥ת בֵּית־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And also burnt offering [was] in abundance, with [the] fat of the peace offerings and with the drink offerings for the burnt offering. And was established [the] service of [the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: And also burnt offering [was] in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings and with the drink offerings for the burnt offering. And the service of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was established.
en.B: Burnt offerings were also plentiful, together with the fat of the peace offerings and the drink offerings that went with each burnt offering. In this way the service of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house was set in order.
en.R: There were also many burnt offerings, as well as the fat from the peace offerings and the drink offerings that were poured out with the burnt offerings. So the worship in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple was set up again.

es.L: Y también [hubo] holocausto en abundancia, con la grasa de los sacrificios de paz y con las libaciones para el holocausto. Y quedó establecido el servicio de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Hubo además abundancia de holocaustos, junto con la grasa de los sacrificios de paz y las libaciones que acompañaban a cada holocausto. Así quedó restablecido el servicio de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Hubo también muchos holocaustos, además de la grasa de los sacrificios de paz y las ofrendas de vino que se derramaban con los holocaustos. Así se volvió a establecer el culto en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et aussi l’holocauste [était] en abondance, avec la graisse des sacrifices de communion et avec les libations pour l’holocauste. Et le service de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fut rétabli.
fr.B: Les holocaustes furent aussi très nombreux, avec la graisse des sacrifices de communion et les libations qui accompagnaient chaque holocauste. Ainsi fut rétabli le service de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Il y avait aussi beaucoup d’holocaustes, ainsi que la graisse des sacrifices de communion et les libations versées avec les holocaustes. Ainsi le culte du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} a été rétabli.

sw.L: Na pia sadaka ya kuteketezwa [ilikuwa] nyingi, pamoja na mafuta ya sadaka za amani na pamoja na sadaka za kinywaji kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Hivyo huduma ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikaimarishwa.
sw.B: Sadaka za kuteketezwa nazo zilikuwa nyingi, pamoja na mafuta ya sadaka za amani na sadaka za kinywaji zilizoandamana na kila sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Hivyo huduma ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikawekwa katika utaratibu.
sw.R: Kulikuwa pia na sadaka nyingi za kuteketezwa, pamoja na mafuta ya sadaka za amani na sadaka za kinywaji zilizomiminwa pamoja na sadaka za kuteketezwa. Hivyo ibada katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikaanzishwa tena.

vi.L: Của lễ thiêu cũng nhiều, cùng với mỡ của tế lễ bình an và lễ quán dâng kèm của lễ thiêu. Vậy sự phục vụ trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} được thiết lập lại.
vi.B: Của lễ thiêu cũng rất nhiều, cùng với mỡ của các tế lễ bình an và các lễ quán dâng kèm mỗi của lễ thiêu. Như vậy, sự phục vụ trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} được sắp đặt lại.
vi.R: Cũng có rất nhiều của lễ thiêu, cùng với mỡ của các tế lễ bình an và rượu dâng kèm theo các của lễ thiêu. Vậy sự thờ phượng trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} được lập lại.

ko.L: 그리고 또 번제물이 많았고, 화목제물의 기름과 번제에 따르는 전제물도 [많았다]. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 섬김이 바로 세워졌다.
ko.B: 번제물도 많았고, 화목제물의 기름과 각 번제에 따르는 전제물도 많았다. 이렇게 하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 드리는 예배가 다시 질서 있게 세워졌다.
ko.R: 번제물도 많았고, 화목제물에서 떼어 낸 기름과 번제와 함께 부어 드리는 포도주도 많았다. 이렇게 하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 드리는 예배가 다시 시작되었다.

decisions.choice: the fat of the peace offerings and the drink offerings
decisions.reason: The fat of every peace offering was burned on the altar (Leviticus 3:3-5), and each burnt offering was to have its offering of wine poured out (Numbers 15:1-10). All of this added to the priests' work.

decisions.choice: was established: was set in order and made firm
decisions.reason: The verb means to be made ready and firm. After years of neglect, the regular service of the temple was working again (compare 8:16).

decisions.choice: the service: the worship and work of the temple
decisions.reason: The word covers the whole of the work done in Yahweh's house: the offerings, the music and the care of the place.

decisions.choice: set up again
decisions.reason: Readable says "again", since the service had stopped under Ahaz (verse 7).

decisions.choice: "sacrificios de paz"; "libaciones" (L, B); "ofrendas de vino" (R)
decisions.reason: The offerings as the terms note and Spanish Kings name them.

decisions.choice: "tế lễ bình an"; "lễ quán" (L, B); "rượu dâng kèm" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's "tế lễ bình an" for peace offerings and the 2 Kings drafts' "lễ quán" for drink offerings; Readable says what was poured.

decisions.choice: "화목제물" for the peace offerings, "전제물" for the drink offerings
decisions.reason: "화목제" is the terms note's word for peace offerings; Readable says "부어 드리는 포도주" for the drink offering.

source.text: וַיִּשְׂמַ֤ח יְחִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ וְכָל־הָעָ֔ם עַ֛ל הַהֵכִ֥ין הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים לָעָ֑ם כִּ֥י בְּפִתְאֹ֖ם הָיָ֥ה הַדָּבָֽר׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And rejoiced Hezekiah and all the people over that had prepared God for the people, for in suddenness was the thing.

en.L: And Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced over what God had prepared for the people, for the thing had come about suddenly.
en.B: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced over what God had prepared for the people, for the thing had come about suddenly.
en.R: Hezekiah and all the people were glad about what God had done for them, because it had all happened so quickly.

es.L: Y se alegraron Ezequías y todo el pueblo por lo que Dios había preparado para el pueblo, porque la cosa sucedió de repente.
es.B: Ezequías y todo el pueblo se alegraron por lo que Dios había preparado para el pueblo, porque todo había sucedido de repente.
es.R: Ezequías y todo el pueblo estaban felices por lo que Dios había hecho por ellos, porque todo había sucedido muy rápido.

fr.L: Et Ézéchias et tout le peuple se réjouirent de ce que Dieu avait préparé pour le peuple, car la chose s’était faite soudainement.
fr.B: Ézéchias et tout le peuple se réjouirent de ce que Dieu avait préparé pour le peuple, car la chose s’était faite soudainement.
fr.R: Ézéchias et tout le peuple étaient heureux de ce que Dieu avait fait pour eux, parce que tout s’était passé très vite.

sw.L: Hezekia na watu wote wakafurahi juu ya yale ambayo Mungu alikuwa amewaandalia watu, kwa maana jambo hilo lilitokea ghafula.
sw.B: Hezekia na watu wote walifurahi juu ya yale ambayo Mungu alikuwa amewaandalia watu, kwa maana jambo hilo lilikuwa limetokea ghafula.
sw.R: Hezekia na watu wote walifurahi kwa sababu ya yale Mungu aliyowafanyia, kwa sababu yote yalikuwa yametokea upesi sana.

vi.L: Ê-xê-chia và toàn dân vui mừng về điều Đức Chúa Trời đã sắm sẵn cho dân, vì việc ấy xảy ra thật bất ngờ.
vi.B: Ê-xê-chia và toàn dân vui mừng về điều Đức Chúa Trời đã chuẩn bị cho dân, vì việc ấy đến thật bất ngờ.
vi.R: Ê-xê-chia và toàn dân vui mừng vì những gì Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho họ, vì mọi việc diễn ra quá nhanh.

ko.L: 그리고 히스기야와 온 백성이 하나님께서 백성을 위하여 준비하신 일 때문에 기뻐했다. 그 일이 갑자기 이루어졌기 때문이다.
ko.B: 히스기야와 온 백성은 하나님께서 백성을 위하여 마련해 주신 일을 기뻐했다. 그 일이 갑자기 이루어졌기 때문이다.
ko.R: 히스기야와 모든 백성은 하나님께서 그들을 위해 하신 일을 보고 기뻐했다. 그 모든 일이 아주 빨리 이루어졌기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: what God had prepared: the article used as "what"
alternatives: because God had made the people ready
decisions.reason: The article stands before the verb here in the sense "that which". God is the one who had made things ready for the people. Some read it as "because God had made the people ready".

decisions.choice: suddenly: quickly and unexpectedly
decisions.reason: The word means suddenly or without warning. The temple, shut for years, was cleansed and its worship restored within sixteen days (verse 17).

decisions.choice: they rejoiced over what God had done
decisions.reason: Chronicles sees the speed of the change as God's work, not only the king's, and joy is its mark of worship that pleases him (30:21, 26).

decisions.choice: what God had done for them; so quickly
decisions.reason: Readable says "done" for "prepared" and "so quickly" for "suddenly".
